_comment: References the workspace's A/B + copy-fidelity gates compare against. tools/fetch-snapshots.mjs materializes these into .cache/snapshots/ (gitignored). A ref with a `bundle` field materializes from a committed local git bundle (durable, reproducible on clone); a ref with only `repo`+`sha` clones the remote at that SHA. The frozen sibling checkouts under /Users/jhp/code/jackhp95 remain read-only and are no longer the reference for these two.
_comment_elm_cem: elm-cem's generator forked AHEAD of upstream main (ad5d523) at the R-025 emitter change (D-045/D-046): M3e.Build.<X> now routes phantom types through the exposed M3e.Component.<X> surface. That change is workspace-only and un-upstreamed, so Face A (ab-elm-cem) can no longer compare against a remote SHA. The reference is now a committed git bundle of the workspace generator itself (post-change); Face A thus catches FUTURE accidental generator drift and forces a conscious re-baseline (re-bundle + bump sha) on any intended generator change. See D-046. RE-BASELINED at the component-merge + R-026 integration (L7): the bundle is a fresh `git archive HEAD:packages/elm-cem` of the COMBINED generator — component-ctor + R-025 re-applied + families layer + the R-026 opaque-Name gen-icon-module.js change — so Face A compares against the generator that actually ships on this branch (sha e5f2b9a8 -> 035b1852). This is the D-046 standing rule exercised for two intended, composed generator changes, not drift; both the standalone adopt-component and r026-icon-cap bundles are superseded because neither carried BOTH deltas. RE-BASELINED AGAIN (2026-08-18): the generator gained new `## Examples` doc emission (Toolbar/Tooltip/Tree/TreeItem/etc., driven by config/examples.generated.json growth) since the 035b1852 bundle; that snapshot never carried the Examples-emission code, so Face A was comparing against a stale generator, not the intended combined one. Fresh `git archive HEAD:packages/elm-cem` re-bundled (sha 035b1852 -> e8be491b), confirmed byte-identical A/B after re-baseline. RE-BASELINED AGAIN (2026-08-21, reconciliation Task 8): the shared emitter moved twice since e8be491b — the barrel-in-core edit (reconciliation Tasks 2/3, `<Lib>.Internal.Types.<Component>` now holds the phantom-type definitions behind the exposed `<Lib>.Element.<Component>` producer module) and the atomic namespace rename (reconciliation Task 7: `M3e.Component.*`->`M3e.Element.*`, `M3e.Family.*`->`M3e.Component.*`, `TypedHtml.Component.*`->`TypedHtml.Element.*`, `TypedSvg.Component.*`->`TypedSvg.Element.*`, `Sl.Component.*`->`Sl.Element.*`). Neither change was captured by e8be491b, so Face A was comparing the live generator against a two-generations-stale snapshot. Fresh `git archive HEAD:pipeline/elm-cem` re-bundled at the Task 7 commit (3e77975e) (sha e8be491b -> c054df46), confirmed byte-identical A/B after re-baseline. RE-BASELINED AGAIN (2026-08-21, DAG-rework Task 8): the shared emitter moved again since c054df46 — the linear `IR → Core → Elements → Components → Builders` DAG was materialized (DAG-rework Tasks 1-4): a NEW `codegen/Generate/Phantom/Emit/BuildPackage.elm` config-driven family-builder emitter now emits one composed `M3e.Build.<Family>` per `_families` entry (plus degenerate single-member families for standalone elements) importing `M3e.Component.<Family>`, replacing the OLD per-element `compBuildModule` that emitted one `M3e.Build.<Element>` per CEM element importing `M3e.Element.<X>`; `Emit.elm` (drop per-element Build from the concatMap, wire BuildPackage.files) and `FamilyPackage.elm` moved with it, and three gate-support bin scripts (acid.js/registry-check.js/validate.js) stage the split siblings. Neither delta was captured by c054df46 (its pristine tree still emitted the OLD `M3e/Build/` per-element tree + `M3e/Build.elm` barrel — `Only in out-pristine/M3e: Build`), so Face A was comparing the live generator against a one-generation-stale snapshot. This bundle carries ONLY what is on branch `docs/dag-rework-plan` (workspace HEAD 45f28d31) — it does NOT include the sibling `docs/families-a11y-composition-plan` branch's `shared:interactive` field split (718d44d1) or `!@set/!kind` admits primitive (7721dd6c), which are not ancestors of this HEAD. Fresh `git archive HEAD:pipeline/elm-cem` re-bundled (sha c054df46 -> 0d25913d), confirmed byte-identical A/B after re-baseline.
